result.finding: Logback for logging, Micrometer with AOP-based @Timed metrics, and Prometheus metrics export. Jolokia JMX bridge is also configured for runtime log-level management.
evidence: logback-spring.xml: Logback logging with Spring Boot base configuration and <jmxConfigurator/> for Jolokia JMX log-level management
MetricConfig.java: Registers TimedAspect bean to enable AOP-based @Timed metrics collection via MeterRegistry
OwnerResource.java: @Timed('petclinic.owner') on controller class - all owner endpoints measured
PetResource.java: @Timed('petclinic.pet') on controller class - all pet endpoints measured
pom.xml: micrometer-registry-prometheus - Prometheus metrics endpoint via Spring Boot Actuator
pom.xml: jolokia-core 1.7.1 - JMX-HTTP bridge for runtime monitoring
values: Jolokia 1.7.1 (JMX-HTTP bridge for runtime log-level management)
Spring Boot Actuator (health, info, metrics endpoints)
